# licensed work

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:licensedWork`](gmeow-licensedWork.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/licensedWork>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The work a licence grants rights in. Functional.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:License`](../classes/gmeow-License.md) -> [`gmeow:InformationObject`](../classes/gmeow-InformationObject.md); functional

Use [`gmeow:licensedWork`](gmeow-licensedWork.md) from [`gmeow:License`](../classes/gmeow-License.md) to [`gmeow:InformationObject`](../classes/gmeow-InformationObject.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to bind the work a licence grants rights in to the [`gmeow:License`](../classes/gmeow-License.md) relator — the work-side player of the licence.

### Avoid when

- Avoid binding several works to one licence (it is functional — each licensed work has its own [`License`](../classes/gmeow-License.md) relator, or one shared SPDX-identified licence is referenced per work) and avoid using it as the asset-to-licence link, which is [`gmeow:hasLicense`](gmeow-hasLicense.md).

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:licensedWork`](gmeow-licensedWork.md) once per [`License`](../classes/gmeow-License.md) (functional) to the [`gmeow:InformationObject`](../classes/gmeow-InformationObject.md) it covers, mirroring the work's [`gmeow:hasLicense`](gmeow-hasLicense.md).
